newsitem.title: USA: Transocean had unfavorable turnkey results.
newsitem.headline: Transocean had unfavorable turnkey results.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc said Thursday it experienced "unfavorable" results in its turnkey operations during the fourth quarter.
Transocean's stock dropped 2-1/8 to 20-3/8 and was one of the most active issues on the New York Stock Exchange.
"The stock activity is related to uncertainty about the fourth quarter results," said Transocean spokesman Jeffrey Chastain.
The Houston-based offshore drilling company, however, declined to comment on whether the unfavorable turnkey events would hurt its fourth quarter earnings.

Transocean said it will continue to review its financial results and will alert Wall Street analysts and shareholders if its fourth quarter earnings will differ from its current "guidance" or projections, Chastain said.
Analysts expect Transocean to post fourth quarter earnings of $0.55 a share, compared to earnings of $0.39 a share last year.
Transocean declined to provide further details.
Carol Lau, an analyst with Oppenheimer & Co, said the company had problems in two of four wells in the turnkey sector and will absorb those costs in the fourth quarter.
Lau said investors overreacted to the problems, since the turnkey sector represents a small portion of Transocean's revenues.
Lau said she has not changed her fourth quarter earnings estimate of $0.53 share.
